title: Move Draw Plugin Camera To Runtime State
description: Apply the camera-to-runtime-state recipe (already applied to puzzle 2d/3d/5d, raster, trinity, architect, cad, fem 2d/3d, shooting, writer, sequence, mathematical, lowpoly) to the draw plugin, which a completeness critic found was missed. In semio-s-app-draw-ui: change the setCamera/setCameraZoom action builders from ActionKind::Operation to the View-kind builder, change their handlers to write to a new runtime/session camera field instead of emitting DrawOperation::SetCamera, and change scene-rendering code to read the camera from runtime instead of the document. In semio-s-app-draw-op: delete the DrawOperation::SetCamera variant and every diff/apply/absorb/backwards/DSL match arm referencing it. Hand-fix fixtures/tests referencing the old document camera field or deleted operation across the draw plugin tree. Verify with cargo check --all-targets and cargo test --lib for every touched crate.
summary:
Applied the camera-to-runtime-state recipe (already done for puzzle 2d/3d/5d, raster, trinity, architect, cad, fem 2d/3d, shooting, writer, sequence, mathematical, lowpoly) to the draw plugin, which a completeness sweep had missed.

ActionKind changes (semio-s-app-draw-ui): `setCamera` and `setCameraZoom` changed from `.action_with(draw_internal_action(id, label, ActionKind::Operation))` to the same builder with `ActionKind::View`, moved into the "Ephemeral view state" registration block.

New runtime field: added `camera: draw::DrawCamera` (with `#[serde(default)]`) to the existing ephemeral `DrawInteractionState` struct (this app has no separate "...Runtime"/"...PlayRuntime" struct — `DrawInteractionState` already is that role, holding `selected_ids`/`hovered_id`/`engagement_input`). Added `impl Default for DrawCamera` in the domain crate (x:512, y:512, zoom:0.75 — matches the pre-migration `default_draw_document` camera exactly, so a fresh app's initial view is unchanged).

Handler rewrite: `setCamera`/`setCameraZoom` now write directly into `self.interaction.camera` and return `ActionEmit::default()` (zero operations) instead of constructing `DrawOperation::SetCamera`. All camera reads (`apply_point_pick`, `commit_trace_at`, `render_canvas`'s `Canvas2dScene` construction, and the `canvasPointerDown/Move/Up` handlers' `canvas_point_to_world`/tolerance calculations) now read `interaction.camera` / `self.interaction.camera` instead of `document.camera`.

Deleted operation variant: `DrawOperation::SetCamera { camera: DrawCamera }` removed from semio-s-app-draw-op's enum, along with its `apply_draw_edit_operation` match arm, its `Operation::diff` match arm, the `camera: Option<DrawCamera>` field on `DrawDiff` (and its `apply`/`absorb` handling). No DSL/known-keys table referenced the operation name directly (the `dsl::DslOps` derive generates parsing from the enum itself, so removing the variant removed its DSL surface automatically).

Document field removal: removed `camera: DrawCamera` (was `#[dsl(block)]`) from `DrawDocument` in the domain crate (semio-s-app-draw). `DrawCamera` itself stays (now only used as the ui crate's runtime-camera type, matching the analogous pattern already used by `RasterCamera` in the raster plugin).

Fixtures/tests hand-fixed:
- ✏️s/🔌plugin/🖍️draw/📚example/🖍️semio.draw: dropped the `camera { x=100 y=100 zoom=1.2 }` block (document no longer has a camera field; raster's analogous example has no camera block either).
- op/pack/dsl crates' `representative_draw_document()` test fixtures: dropped the `camera: DrawCamera {...}` struct-literal field (4 call sites: domain doesn't have one, but op/pack/dsl each keep a private copy per this repo's "each crate keeps its own private copy" convention).
- semio-s-app-draw-op tests: removed `SetCamera` from `op_text_round_trips_every_draw_operation_variant`, removed the `with_camera`/`camera_op`/absorb-camera assertions from `apply_draw_edit_operation_covers_remaining_variants` and `draw_operation_diff_apply_absorb_and_backwards_round_trip` (the `_` fallback diff branch stays covered via the existing `fill_op` case).
- semio-s-app-draw-dsl: renamed/simplified `draw_document_parse_dsl_reports_errors_for_missing_camera_and_unknown_layer_kind` to `draw_document_parse_dsl_reports_error_for_unknown_layer_kind`, dropping the now-inapplicable "missing camera block must fail to parse" assertion and its now-invalid camera-block-containing DSL text.
- semio-s-app-draw-protocol: `op_binary_round_trips_and_agrees_with_text` no longer builds a `SetCamera` operation from `document.camera`; now round-trips an `AddLayer` operation instead (matching raster's protocol-crate test pattern).
- semio-s-app-draw-ui: replaced `set_camera_emits_one_coalesced_operation` (asserted 1 operation + `document.camera.zoom`) with two tests modeled on raster/cad's reference tests — `set_camera_writes_runtime_and_emits_no_operations` (asserts zero operations, document unchanged, and the composite scene JSON reflects the new runtime camera) and `set_camera_zoom_updates_zoom_and_keeps_pan_via_runtime` (asserts zoom-only updates preserve pan, zero operations). Both use plain `new_app()` (not `new_app_with_registry()`) to avoid an unrelated pre-existing icon-catalog panic in the full registry build (see below) — matches the precedent set by raster's own camera tests, which also don't exercise the real registry.
- `marquee_select_covers_contained_layer_only`'s existing camera-pin comment/call needed no changes — it already dispatches through `setCamera`, which now writes runtime state that the same test's `canvasPointerDown/Move/Up` calls read back from, so behavior is unchanged.

Verification (cargo check --all-targets / cargo test --lib, run per-crate and combined):
- semio-s-app-draw: check clean; 0 tests (lib has none).
- semio-s-app-draw-dsl: check clean; 4/4 passed.
- semio-s-app-draw-engine: check clean; 37/37 passed.
- semio-s-app-draw-op: check clean; 7/7 passed.
- semio-s-app-draw-pack: check clean; 3/3 passed.
- semio-s-app-draw-protocol: check clean; 2/2 passed.
- semio-s-app-draw-ui: check clean; 20/25 passed. The 5 failures (catalogue_panel_lists_boolean_operations, draw_labels_translate_panels_in_german, set_active_utility_clears_scratch_and_emits_no_history_entry, shape_rect_drag_commits_one_layer_and_requests_utility_reset, utility_registry_declares_all_canvas_utilities_scoped_to_the_window) are a single pre-existing, unrelated bug: the shared icon catalog (icon_name.rs) has no "scan-line" icon (only "scan"), but draw's Trace-layer icon and "trace" utility use the literal "scan-line", so any code path building the full manifest/registry or the catalogue panel panics on `IconName::from("scan-line")`. Confirmed pre-existing and unrelated via `git diff --cached`/`git log` — my diff touches zero icon-related lines, and `scan-line` has been used in this file across many historical commits predating this ticket. Flagged as a separate background-task suggestion (task_a78abda6) rather than fixed here (out of scope for this ticket).
- draw-plugin (manifest/artifact crate, untouched by this ticket): 0/2 passed — both pre-existing and unrelated: `__semio_plugin_sanity_declared_apps_appear_in_bundle_manifest` hits the same scan-line icon panic above, and `__semio_plugin_sanity_constitutional_crates_present` fails a hardcoded relative-path lookup (`../🎛️app`, `../../🎛️app`, `../../../🎛️app`) that doesn't account for this crate's extra `🗿artifact` nesting level — unrelated to camera/view-action work and not modified by this ticket.

Not fully confident about / deviations: DrawCamera's default (512,512,0.75) is a deliberate behavior-preserving choice matching the old document default rather than a "neutral" (0,0,1) default like raster/cad use for their own cameras — flagged in case a plain identity default is preferred instead for consistency with siblings.
